remainingVisualLimits104: Structural and compositional improvement is not photographic fidelity. Main hall joinery, metalwork and gable carving remain visibly simplified and regular compared with the reference.
Garden species, weathering, pond reflections and foreground optical response remain interpretations. Native ambient lighting is not a physical multi-bounce path trace.
The reused seated icon is still an interpretation of an obscured sanctuary; it should not be cited as exact historic iconography.
No finished film or photographic acceptance is claimed by native loading, linked shaders or nonempty pixels.
